title: Previous day's stock price
prompt: Return ticker, price_date, price, and prev_price (the previous day's price for that ticker, using LAG, ordered by price_date within each ticker). prev_price should be NULL when there is no previous row.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE stock_prices (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, ticker TEXT, price_date TEXT, price REAL); INSERT INTO stock_prices VALUES (1,'AAA','2023-01-01',10.0),(2,'AAA','2023-01-02',12.0),(3,'AAA','2023-01-03',11.0),(4,'BBB','2023-01-01',50.0),(5,'BBB','2023-01-02',48.0);
reference_sql: SELECT ticker, price_date, price, LAG(price) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY price_date) AS prev_price FROM stock_prices;
